about.p1: SFGCO TECH is a technology company specializing in enterprise software, cloud computing, AI solutions, and digital innovation. We design, develop, and operate digital solutions built to enterprise-grade standards of security, scalability, and performance.
about.p2: We help startups, SMEs, and large enterprises modernize their infrastructure, automate operations, and build scalable digital products using industry-leading technologies and cloud platforms — delivering secure, intelligent, and future-ready solutions that enable businesses to innovate faster and operate more efficiently.

services.title: Comprehensive Enterprise Technology Services
services.subtitle: From cloud infrastructure to AI and enterprise systems, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions engineered for scale, security, and measurable business value.

s1.title: Cloud Infrastructure & Configuration
s1.desc: We design, deploy, and manage secure, high-performing cloud environments across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud — engineered for resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.

s2.title: Databases & Data Warehouse
s2.desc: We transform raw business data into strategic insight, building scalable, governed data platforms that power confident, data-driven decisions.

s3.title: Mobile & Web Development
s3.desc: We create modern digital experiences — enterprise web applications, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms engineered for performance, usability, and scale.

s4.title: Artificial Intelligence & Large Language Models
s4.desc: We help organizations accelerate with artificial intelligence — from LLM-powered assistants to retrieval-augmented systems that increase productivity and elevate customer experience.

s5.title: System Integration
s5.desc: We connect every system inside your organization into one integrated platform, linking ERP, CRM, payments, government services, and IoT into a single source of truth.

s6.title: Cybersecurity
s6.desc: We protect your business with enterprise-grade security — proactive assessment, continuous monitoring, and compliance built into every layer of your digital infrastructure.

s7.title: ERP Solutions
s7.desc: We streamline operations with intelligent ERP solutions that automate finance, HR, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing across a single unified platform.
